widgets_values:
Step 1 - Load 1 to 4 reference images. I did validate and test it with just a character sheet, so you should be good with just one.

Step 2 - Reset index to 0 and set your queu to the same number of lines in the input prompt master (default 30)

Step 2 - Input the master prompt. This will guide basic details like style and lighting as well as letting you fine tune certain elements. 

Step 3 - Adjust angle prompts if desired. I have 30 in there now. Each line will function as its own run so if you add more or remove some adjust your batch number. 

Step 4 - Set output folder

Step 5 - Hit run

Best practices: 

 

You can adjust outfits and accessories in the Master Prompt, but I think you're better off making a  new reference sheet with those changes instead of hoping all 30 outputs are consistent. Obviously adding in a third reference image with that adjustment will help. 

In theory you could add different backgrounds and settings in the Angle Prompt section. I chose a more neutral approach because that has tended to work best for me when training character loras.
